description.value: Ponderosa Motor Inn is an 85-unit motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, nestled between the Rocky and Selkirk mountain ranges and within reach of six national parks. Golden is a well-known hub for outdoor adventure, and the inn sits at a logical overnight stop for touring cyclists crossing the Rockies or riding the Columbia Valley. A restaurant is located directly adjacent to the property, and Kicking Horse Mountain Resort is a short distance away.
